description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and type hinting logic for handling data types, especially in the context of pandas-on-Spark integration. It includes type conversions between pandas, numpy, and Spark types, as well as functions for inferring return types from annotated functions.

classes.name: SeriesType
classes.description: Represents a column of data with a specific data type and corresponding Spark type.

classes.name: DataFrameType
classes.description: Represents a DataFrame's schema including index and data fields, with methods to access dtypes and Spark type.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Represents a scalar data type understood by Spark.

classes.name: UnknownType
classes.description: Represents an unspecified or unknown data type.

classes.name: IndexNameTypeHolder
classes.description: Holds metadata for index name and type.

classes.name: NameTypeHolder
classes.description: Holds metadata for data field name and type.

methods.name: as_spark_type
methods.description: Converts a Python, numpy, or pandas type into a Spark DataType.

methods.name: spark_type_to_pandas_dtype
methods.description: Converts a Spark DataType into a pandas or numpy dtype.

methods.name: pandas_on_spark_type
methods.description: Converts a Python, numpy, or pandas type into a pandas/numpy dtype and Spark DataType tuple.

methods.name: infer_pd_series_spark_type
methods.description: Infers Spark DataType from a pandas Series dtype.

methods.name: infer_return_type
methods.description: Infers the return type of a function based on its annotations, returning a SeriesType, DataFrameType, ScalarType, or UnknownType.

methods.name: create_type_for_series_type
methods.description: Creates a SeriesType class for a given dtype or extension dtype.

methods.name: create_tuple_for_frame_type
methods.description: Supports variadic generic typing for DataFrame schemas, returning a tuple of type holders.
